description: 'Ask the pipeline': read-only tools over the Dagster instance (recent failures, run summary, redacted run logs, asset status, lineage, stale assets, receipt stats) for agents. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server (python component.py) for agentic_pipeline's tool_use_loop / mcp_call.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under (default dagster_instance_tools).

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: list_recent_failures, get_run_summary, get_run_logs, asset_status, asset_lineage, stale_assets, receipt_stats.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result (lists are halved / strings clipped, result flagged truncated).

definitions_module.label: Definitions Module
definitions_module.description: Optional 'pkg.module[:attr]' yielding your Definitions (attr defaults to `defs`). Enables downstream lineage, partition totals/missing, and data-version staleness; without it those degrade to event-log-only answers.

store_resource_key.label: Receipt Store Resource Key
store_resource_key.description: Optional resource key of a ContextReceiptStore; enables receipt_stats (asset_usage_since / outcomes_by_code_version).

name: dagster_instance_tools
